messages.subject: error in longitudinal measurement invariance
parts:
Dear all,

I am examining the longitudinal weak measurement invariance of a construct.
I specified the syntay with lavaan and got results one month ago.
Tody, I wanted to write down the results and got an error message when fitting the model: 
Error in chol.default(S) : 
  the leading minor of order 12 is not positive definite. 
 What does it mean? Can I do anything?

The syntax reads as follows:


model_pmhweak <- '
pmh_t1 =~ a1*pmh14_1_t1+ a2*pmh14_2_t1+ a3*pmh14_4_t1+a4*pmh14_5_t1+a5*pmh14_7_t1+ a6*pmh14_9_t1+ a7*pmh14_10_t1+a8*pmh14_11_t1+  a9*pmh14_13_t1
pmh14_1_t1~~pmh14_2_t1
